description: A fresh western disturbance is expected to influence weather across north India next week, bringing light rain and snowfall to hill states while Delhi-NCR is likely to remain dry until November 8. Meanwhile, severe air pollution persists across the region, and rainfall is set to continue in parts of southern India despite Cyclone Murasu weakening.

title: Rupee slips 9 paise to 94.55 against US dollar in early trade
description: The rupee weakened by 9 paise to 94.55 against the US dollar in early trade on Thursday due to the broad strength of the American currency overseas, although gains in domestic equities and softer crude oil prices helped limit losses.

title: Fire breaks out at Pure EV manufacturing plant in Kandi
description: Spare parts at Pure EV's manufacturing unit near IITH, Kandi, were destroyed in a fire on Thursday morning. Firefighters brought the blaze under control after several hours, and police registered a case while the cause and extent of losses were being assessed.

title: Heavy security deployed as Andhra Pradesh votes in MPTC and ZPTC elections
description: Polling for Andhra Pradesh's MPTC and ZPTC elections began across 31,460 centres on Thursday with over 2.61 crore voters eligible to cast their ballots. The State Election Commission deployed extensive security and polling staff, with additional forces in sensitive districts. Polling was postponed in a few mandals of Eluru and East Godavari districts due to heavy rain.

title: After conductor’s death, TGSRTC mandates closed passenger doors on moving buses
description: TGSRTC has mandated that buses equipped with passenger doors operate only with the doors closed while in motion following the death of conductor Gundla Pravalika. The corporation has directed officials to ensure all bus doors are functional and safety measures are strictly enforced.

title: All 11 missing rescuers rescued after boats capsize in Khammam’s Bethupalli lake
description: All 11 SDRF, Fire Services personnel and a local resident who went missing after two rescue boats capsized in the flood-swollen Bethupalli Lake in Khammam district were rescued by Thursday morning. The joint NDRF and Fire Services operation successfully traced and rescued both the stranded fishermen and the missing rescue team members.

title: Iran hails US midterm election results as rejection of Trump’s war policy
description: Iranian leaders hailed the US midterm election outcome as a rejection of President Donald Trump’s war stance, while warning Washington against ignoring voters’ message. The result boosted morale in Tehran amid tensions over possible renewed US military action against Iran, even as anti-American demonstrations marked the anniversary of the 1979 US Embassy takeover.

title: Over 30 Indian American candidates secure State Legislative seats across US
description: Indian American Democrats scored major gains in US state elections, with at least 30 candidates winning legislative seats. Leaders like Ranjeev Puri in Michigan and Priya Sundareshan in Arizona are positioned for top legislative roles as Democrats regained control in key states. Indian American candidates also secured several historic victories across the country.
